nodes.label: graphify-out/graph.json
nodes.rationale: Rewritten whole on every build, so large PR diffs are expected and should not be flagged as churn.

nodes.label: graphify update . (AST-only refresh)
nodes.rationale: Keeps the graph current after code edits with no API cost.

nodes.label: Graphify Usage Rules (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: Query the scoped graph before grepping or reading raw files, because the subgraph is much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output.

nodes.label: LoopbackResult / ChannelResult (unchanged)
nodes.rationale: error and residual are kept because the results table still reports resid and rms.

nodes.label: _setup_transfer(ax, ch, sent, labels)
nodes.rationale: Equal axis limits on both axes make a flat or swapped channel obvious.

nodes.label: Transfer Plot Title (gain/offset/noise)
nodes.rationale: Gain is nan for a constant sent channel, so the title shows "constant" instead.

nodes.label: Loopback Panel View Radio Buttons
nodes.rationale: Radio buttons are disabled during a run because rebuilding the live plot halfway through isn't worth the complexity.

nodes.label: Plan: Sent vs Received View
nodes.rationale: The Difference graph (residual after removing gain/offset) is mostly noise and rarely helps debugging; a received-vs-sent transfer plot exposes faults as recognizable shapes.

nodes.label: Transfer Plot Fault Signatures
nodes.rationale: Tilt=gain error, shift=offset, downward slope=inverted input, flat=disconnected, cloud=AO0/AO1 swapped, bent ends=clipping, thickness=noise.
